verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a SaaS fraud-protection service that processes merchant order data, so an opt-out from AI model training is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no training opt-out or data-use control. The sensitive-data protection layer only rejects unwanted sensitive data at the API. That is an adjacent control, not a way to keep submitted data out of model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
